sources.entry: Nogrammerly - On-device writing assistant that checks spelling, grammar and tone and rewrites text in any app, using Apple Intelligence.

summary.one_liner: Nogrammerly is a free, open-source, on-device writing assistant for Mac and Windows that checks spelling, grammar, clarity and tone and offers one-click rewrites across most apps.
summary.what_it_does: It underlines spelling, grammar and style issues in the focused text field of almost any app, using the macOS Accessibility API on Mac or UI Automation on Windows. Right-clicking an underline offers Replace, Copy suggestion, Rewrite sentence, Ignore or Add to dictionary. A floating button in the field rewrites the selection or whole text as Professional, Friendly, Confident or Concise. On Mac it also includes a built-in editor window with a writing score, tone picker and Rewrite button. AI proofreading and rewrites use the on-device model (Apple Foundation Models on Mac, Phi Silica on Windows Copilot+ PCs), and the README says text never leaves the device. Without AI hardware it still provides spelling, grammar and style checks using the system spell checker and built-in rules.
use_cases: check spelling and grammar while typing in any app
rewrite an email or message in a more professional or friendly tone
private proofreading without sending text to a cloud service
free alternative to a Grammarly subscription on Mac or Windows
fix writing in Slack, Teams, Outlook or Mail
build or modify a macOS or Windows writing assistant from source
how_to_run: Mac: download Nogrammerly-Installer.dmg, drag Nogrammerly into Applications, and open it (approve it in System Settings › Privacy & Security if macOS blocks it)
Mac: grant Accessibility permission in the Setup window
Windows (beta): download the x64 or arm64 zip, extract it, and double-click Install.cmd
Build on Mac: ./script/create_dmg.sh to produce the installer; swift test runs WritingEngine tests
Windows source is C# on .NET 10 in the windows/ folder and must be built on Windows
notable: Runs the language model fully on-device; no account needed and works offline
Right-click underlines to replace, rewrite sentence or add to dictionary, with undo (⌘Z) preserved
Works without AI hardware, falling back to spelling and style rules
Separate Mac (Swift) and Windows (C#) apps following the same read, analyse, draw and replace pipeline
caveats: Mac AI checks need macOS 26+ with Apple Intelligence; Mac requires macOS 14+ on Apple silicon
Windows AI requires a Copilot+ PC with Developer Mode on; the Windows version is marked beta
The Mac app is not notarized and the Windows app is not code-signed, so OS security warnings must be bypassed
Some apps do not report text positions, so underlines may not appear there
